config.derived_query: National plumbing and drain-cleaning service franchises for residential and commercial customers

candidates.name: Rooter-Man
candidates.description: Rooter-Man fits because it is an "international franchisor of Plumbing and Drain Cleaning Services" offering "plumbing, sewer, and drain cleaning services" for its "638 active franchises".
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable plumbing and drain-cleaning franchise with similar residential/commercial customer base and scale.

candidates.name: 1-Tom-Plumber Franchise HQ
candidates.description: 1-Tom-Plumber Franchise HQ matches the trait as a "nationally recognized plumbing franchise brand" specializing in "emergency plumbing, drain clearing" and serving both "commercial and residential leads".
candidates.rationale: Same business model: national plumbing/drain-cleaning franchise serving residential and commercial customers.

candidates.name: Mr Rooter Plumbing Central Florida
candidates.description: Mr. Rooter Plumbing Central Florida matches because it is "the largest all-franchised, full-service plumbing and drain service company in the world" and its franchisees serve "residential, commercial, and industrial customers".
candidates.rationale: Same plumbing and drain-cleaning franchise model, serving similar residential and commercial customers.

candidates.name: Metro Plumb
candidates.description: Metro Plumb fits because it is explicitly a "national plumbing franchise" offering "a complete home and commercial plumbing solution" through "more than 30 regional plumbing centres across the UK".
candidates.rationale: National plumbing/drain services franchise serving residential and commercial customers; same business model and buyer base.

candidates.name: Mr. Rooter Plumbing of the Twin Cities
candidates.description: It fits because it is a plumbing franchise serving both residential and commercial customers, with "plumbing, gas, drain and sewer experts" and "residential and commercial plumbing services" including "drain cleaning".
candidates.rationale: Same plumbing and drain-cleaning franchise model, serving residential and commercial customers; highly similar local market counterpart.

candidates.name: Metro Rod (Hull, Lincolnshire Peterborough)
candidates.description: It fits because it is a drainage and plumbing franchise network with "drain clearance" and "plumbing" services, backed by a "network of over 300 highly trained drainage engineers" and franchise ownership.
candidates.rationale: UK drainage and plumbing franchise network with similar services and customer base to Roto-Rooter.

candidates.name: The Plumbing Doctor
candidates.description: It fits because it is a plumbing and drain-cleaning service company with "service and repair plumbing" and "Sewer & Drain Cleaning", and it states that "Franchise opportunities are currently available".
candidates.rationale: Same plumbing and drain-cleaning service model, similar customer base, and comparable franchise/service business.

candidates.name: Roto-Rooter Corp.
candidates.description: It matches because it is the company behind the franchise brand and is described as "the largest provider of plumbing and drain cleaning services in North America" with "Franchising of the service followed".
candidates.rationale: Duplicate/parent entity of the seed brand, not a separate lookalike company.
